_: The sync PROTOCOL contract: the rules a client and the server must agree on,
written down once instead of one side reading the other's source.
It exists because the two facts below used to live in CalMind's
server/lib/app.php and were read OUT of that PHP by core tests — including
ChefMind's, which had to reach into a sibling checkout to run at all, and
skipped when there was not one. A contract that only one party holds is not
a contract; it is a file the other party hopes is still there.
Both sides assert against THIS file now: CalMind's core test proves app.php
and core agree with it (the server side nothing used to check), and every
client core proves its own constants match. Change a value here and both
sides go red, which is the point.
MyCalMind does not carry this file: it has no server and speaks no
recIdPatternSource: app.php REC_ID_RE — every record id a client mints must match, or the server refuses the record and it stays dirty on one device for ever
maxBatchSource: app.php MAX_BATCH — the most changes the server takes in one push; core's SYNC_MAX_BATCH must equal it, or a full batch is either refused whole or silently truncated
